sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
Wear the Unstoppable Rice Chain Bracelet around your wrist as a stylish crystal energy jewellery piece.
Before wearing, hold the bracelet for a few seconds and set an intention for confidence, courage, success, focus, Solar Plexus energy, and unstoppable growth.
Secure it properly using the lobster lock closure for a comfortable and firm wrist fit.
Style it with T-shirts, shirts, jackets, kurtas, office looks, casual outfits, or evening wear for a bold and premium look.
You can wear it alone as a statement bracelet or stack it with other bracelets for a stronger, aesthetic wrist style.
Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain the 24K gold plated Rice Chain shine and crystal bead quality.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Vision | Confidence | Success | Feminine Energy

From the Studd Muffyn Crystal Collection – India’s Largest Crystal Brand, this bracelet is designed for those who want their jewellery to feel powerful, meaningful, and stylish at the same time. It carries a bold success-driven energy while still keeping the look elegant, minimal, and feminine.

 Why “Unstoppable”?
The name Unstoppable comes from the powerful combination of Tiger Eye and Pyrite — one supports courage and focus, while the other supports prosperity and confidence. It is commonly connected with the Solar Plexus Chakra, supporting willpower, ambition, self-belief, and personal power.

Key Highlights

• Rice Chain StylingThe Rice Chain adds a clean, premium, and stylish look to the bracelet, making it perfect for everyday fashion.

• Secure Lobster Lock ClosureDesigned with a lobster lock for easy wearing, better grip, and a neat jewellery finish.

• Aesthetic Everyday JewelleryPerfect for daily wear, office looks, casual outfits, festive styling, travel, meditation, or gifting.

The bracelet is designed for those who want to carry confidence, protection, prosperity, and unstoppable energy with them every day.

Disclaimer: Crystals serve as supportive tools for positive intention and mindful living. Personal hard work, conscious action, and practical decision-making remain essential. Natural crystals may show slight variations in colour, texture, shape, and finish.
